integrity: The universal proof is analytic. Exact-rational finite checks are supporting reproducibility evidence, not a replacement for induction. No independent expert audit.
scientific_limitations: The lower bound is against deterministic online rules and adaptive eligibility choices; no randomized oblivious-input lower bound, fixed-agent sharp factor, or heterogeneous-cost extension is asserted. Priority in unindexed literature is unresolved.
title: The exact eligibility-rank frontier for online chore proportionality up to one item
